results.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
results.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

results.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
results.overview: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

results.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
results.overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

results.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
results.overview: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits — fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

results.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
results.original_title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
results.overview: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.

results.title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of the Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
results.original_title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of the Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
results.overview: Join visionary director James Gunn and superstars such as Chris Pratt and Zoe Saldaña as they recount how “Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3” was conceived, shaped, and delivered to the world. And stand alongside the cast and crew in the emotional final moments of the shoot as they bid farewell to each other, and close this chapter in the saga of Peter Quill and his loveable band of misfit-warriors.

results.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Guardians of the Galaxy - The Thanos Threat
results.original_title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Guardians of the Galaxy - The Thanos Threat
results.overview: The Guardians are on a mission to deliver the Build Stone to the Avengers before the Ravagers, Thanos and his underlings steal it from them.

results.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Guardians of the Galaxy: The Thanos Threat
results.original_name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Guardians of the Galaxy: The Thanos Threat
results.overview: When Thanos, Ronan, Nebula and the Ravagers seek to possess the Build Stone, the fate of the universe depends on the Guardians of the Galaxy to protect it.

results.name: The Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers
results.original_name: The Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers
results.overview: Four elite Galaxy Rangers with unique abilities defend law & order among the space colonies and protect humanity from the evil Crown Empire.
